name: Image card
summary: One photo with a caption, an optional credit line and an optional button, for when the answer is a picture of something.
use: when an answer is best shown as one photo of a place, dish, product or room, with a line about it
a11y: A figure whose caption is its figcaption; the photo carries alt text from the data, and the optional button is a real button.

use_when: the person asked to see something, and one photo with a line of context answers it
avoid_when: several photos or options to choose between: use result-list
a product with a price to buy: use product-card
a place to find: use location-card

parts.name: caption
parts.what: one or two sentences about the photo

parts.name: credit
parts.what: who took the photo or where it is from

empty.how: without a photo, answer in text; the card is only for a picture

loading.how: the photo box keeps its 3:2 shape in a sunken colour while the image loads

error.how: a photo that fails to load is replaced by its alt text in the same box (the renderer swaps it and keeps the class)

disabled.how: a disabled or still-loading button turns quiet neutral (secondary text on a subtle fill), still readable at AA

overflow.how: on a phone the button moves under the caption

long_text.how: caption and credit wrap, also long words

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches the button when there is one
